开源社（\"KAIYUANSHE®\"）成立于 2014 年，是由志愿贡献于开源: KaiSource was founded in 2014 by volunteers who care about open source. We work through contribution, consensus, and co-governance. We are vendor-neutral, non-profit, and focused on the public good. Our goal is to connect China with the global open source community and help build a healthy, lasting ecosystem.
开源社是中国领先的，纯社区驱动，中立开放的组织，积极与支持开源的社区、高校、企业: KaiSource is a leading volunteer-led open source community in China. We work with communities, universities, companies, public organizations, and government teams. We were the first organization from China to join the Open Source Initiative as an affiliate member. We were also named Open Source Community of the Year on China's Open Source Innovation List.
开源社自2016年起连续举办中国开源年会（COSCon），持续发布 《中国开源年: Since 2016, KaiSource has hosted the China Open Source Conference (COSCon), published the China Open Source Annual Report, and helped launch programs that recognize open source contributors. Over the past decade, we have connected tens of thousands of people, worked with thousands of members and volunteers, and partnered with speakers, sponsors, media outlets, and communities in China and abroad.
